get.description:
Merges three sources into one paginated list: ExcessBuyback items, completed internal-vendor MasterLeads (B2C in-house) and B2BDealItems from deals in PaymentComplete. Everything before the financial-year start date is hidden and results are cached in Redis for 60 seconds.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. pagination.total is only an approximation (sum of the fetched batches, not a real count). Sold masterLeadIds are cached in Redis for 5 minutes under inventory:soldLeadIds.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches device name/model, serial/IMEI, vendor first name or brand

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: B2C | B2B | Excess — selects which of the three sources are queried

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ExcessBuyback status filter; defaults to InStock so sold items are hidden

parameters.name: oldInventory
parameters.description: Pass 'true' to show only items older than 30 days (still within the financial year)

post.description:
Creates a single InStock ExcessBuyback row. The requirement source or external vendor name is appended into the condition string, and a transaction id is required for non-cash payments.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity INVENTORY). No handler-level auth check. Does not invalidate the inventory:* Redis keys, so the GET can lag by up to 60 seconds.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Transaction ID is required for Bank/UPI payments

post.description:
Validates a list of devices and createMany's them as InStock ExcessBuyback rows. Purchase-type specific fields (vendorId, externalVendorName, requirementSource) are required per type and the external vendor / requirement source is folded into the condition string.

**Notes:** Writes inventory (money-relevant purchase records). Audit-logged (entity INVENTORY). No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/bulk-purchase/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Row 1: Device name, price, and serial/IMEI are required

get.description:
Typeahead over the Customers table by first name, last name or phone, returning up to 10 matches with a flattened primary address. Returns an empty list for queries shorter than 2 characters.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check — exposes customer names, phones and addresses.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/buyers/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term; must be at least 2 characters or an empty result is returned

get.description:
Returns up to 50 SalesCustomer rows newest first, optionally filtered by a name/phone search and by type (Customer or Dealer).

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Backed by the SalesCustomer table (not Customers).

_Source: `app/api/inventory/customers/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on firstName, lastName or phone

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: 'Customer' or 'Dealer'; any other value is ignored

post.description:
Creates a SalesCustomer after checking that the phone is exactly 10 digits and not already registered. Any type other than 'Dealer' is stored as 'Customer'.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity CUSTOMER). No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/customers/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Phone number must be exactly 10 digits
Customer with this phone already exists

get.description:
Returns PurchaseContact rows sorted by name, optionally filtered by a name or phone substring.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/purchase-contacts/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match on name or phone

post.summary: Create or update a purchase contact
post.description:
Upserts a PurchaseContact keyed on the whitespace-stripped phone number: an existing row has its name updated, otherwise a new contact is created.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check and no audit wrapper. Posting an existing phone silently renames that contact.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/purchase-contacts/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.description:
Aggregates InternalSale revenue, cost and profit for the chosen period along with current in-stock count and value, plus a per-sale date/amount series for charting.

**Notes:** force-dynamic. No handler-level auth check — exposes revenue and margin figures.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/reports/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.description:
Creates an InternalSale in a transaction, marks each sold item's ExcessBuyback row as Sold with its selling price (creating and back-filling a row from the MasterLead when the item is not yet in inventory), and logs the initial payment in SalePaymentLog.

**Notes:** Money-mutating and multi-table: InternalSale, ExcessBuyback and SalePaymentLog. Items not present in ExcessBuyback are created as placeholder Sold rows and then back-filled from the MasterLead if one matches. Audit-logged (entity SALE). No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/sale/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.description:
Simple paginated list of InternalSale rows newest first, each with its sold items (name, serial, cost price and selling price).

**Notes:** force-dynamic. No handler-level auth check. No filters — unlike /api/finance/sales this endpoint has no search or date range.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/sales/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

Typeahead over approved Vendors by first name, last name or phone, returning vendorId, name and phone sorted by first name.

**Notes:** Only isApproved vendors are returned. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/inventory/vendors/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on firstName, lastName or phoneNumber

get.description:
Proxies to the merchandise backend's /orders/admin/list endpoint, forwarding the status, search, limit and offset query parameters, and returns the upstream JSON and status.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL. Absent query params are dropped rather than forwarded as empty values.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/orders/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

Proxies to the merchandise backend's /orders/admin/{id} endpoint and returns its JSON verbatim along with the upstream status code.

**Notes:** Thin proxy to the merchandise service at process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL (via lib/merchandise/proxy merchFetch). Non-2xx upstream statuses are passed straight through.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/orders/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Merchandise order id (URL-encoded before being forwarded)

patch.description:
Forwards the JSON body to the merchandise backend's /orders/{id}/status endpoint and returns the upstream response and status code.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL. The body is forwarded unvalidated, so upstream 4xx bodies surface here with their original status.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/orders/[id]/status/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

get.description:
Proxies to the merchandise backend's /products/admin/list endpoint, forwarding category, limit and offset, and returns the upstream JSON and status.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/products/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

post.description:
Forwards the JSON body to the merchandise backend's /products endpoint as a POST and returns the upstream response and status.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL; no local validation, so the success status mirrors whatever the merchandise backend returns.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/products/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

put.description:
Forwards the JSON body to the merchandise backend's /products/{id} endpoint as a PUT and returns the upstream response and status.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL; body passed through untouched.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/products/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

delete.description:
Proxies a DELETE to the merchandise backend's /products/{id} endpoint and returns the upstream response and status.

**Notes:** Proxy to NEXT_PUBLIC_MERCH_API_URL. Deletion semantics (soft vs hard) are decided by the merchandise backend.

_Source: `app/api/merchandise/products/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

ErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ error, details }` where `details` is a string (usually the underlying exception message).

name.description: Product name; the schema is enforced by the merchandise backend, not this route

lastName.description: Surname; stored as empty string when omitted

email.description: Email; stored as empty string when omitted

type.description: 'Dealer' to create a dealer, anything else becomes 'Customer'

items.description: Non-empty array of { id, sellingPrice } — id is an ExcessBuyback id or a MasterLeads leadId

customer.description: Selected SalesCustomer: { customerId, firstName, lastName, phone }; customerId is mandatory

receivedAmount.description: Amount actually collected; defaults to totalAmount

status.description: New order status; validated by the merchandise backend, not by this route

name.description: Product fields are passed through unvalidated; the merchandise backend defines the schema

phone.description: Phone; all whitespace is removed and it is the upsert key

items.description: Non-empty array of { deviceName, price, serial, condition? } — all three of deviceName, price and serial are required per row

purchaseType.description: CashKr Vendor | External Vendor | Requirement; maps to source Excess | External | Requirement

transactionId.description: Required whenever paymentMethod is not Cash

purchaseDate.description: Backdate the createdAt of every row

purchaseContactId.description: PurchaseContact id to attribute the purchase to

vendorId.description: CashKr vendor id, when bought from a vendor

requirementSource.description: Appended to condition when source is 'Requirement'

externalVendorName.description: Appended to condition when source is 'External'

transactionId.description: Required when paymentMethod is not Cash

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
